comment: Both a fantastic professor and person. I don't think I've ever seen someone who is so knowledgeable and passionate. He has a response to literally everything but will never make you feel bad. If you get to take his class you are lucky and you will want to show up every day.

The brightest and most articulate prof I've had. The guy didn't stutter once. He's the definition of an academic. Class is very structured and clear, and he's quite passionate about his subject. However, 15 weeks of voting theory gets old. Discussions posts matter a lot so don't forget them. Def worth taking his class

Dr Kielty is an amazing professor. His style takes some getting used to, but he is so good at teaching the class through socratic seminars. He was very good at keeping his own opinions out of the way and critiqued everyone's arguments equally. Doing the reading is a must for the quizes, but all four papers are very easy if you run them by him first

awesome prof. i've had him for both 262 and 261 and his teaching style takes a sec to get used to, but the courses are super interesting and he's a great teacher even with harder or more confusing material. highly recommend him!!!

I cannot stress enough how much of an AMAZING professor and class this was. It definitely takes a second to get into, and for a while I wasn't sure how I liked it but Kielty is BRILLIANT. Genuinely the best and most intelligent professor I've ever had. It's challenging + makes you think but so so worth it and rewarding. Super fair with grades too.

Readings for every class and either before, in, or after class quiz. Quizzes are easy if you do the readings and answer the questions. Also graded on participation, discussion posts, and papers. AMAZING professor and class, challenging and really makes you think but so so worth it and rewarding. Whole class is discussion based.

Incredibly smart but intense because he expects a lot from his students in my opinion. Definitely some complex topics and the readings are hard but not the hardest class by any means. He's chill though

Kielty: I don't think there is a professor that is fairer or cares about students more than Kielty he is genuine and wants everyone to do well. He does such an amazing job of making the material understandable & grades giving you the benefit of the doubt 

Class: class is hard, lots of reading, quizzes every class, dense material but so rewarding

Overall Dr. Kielty is a great professor. I liked the way class was led and the discussions were engaging. However, it can be boring on some days and felt repetitive. Participation was vital. The 4 essays due were short, but I wish we had more guidance on them or lighter readings prior to their due dates.
Great Professor! Highly suggest for PPEL

There are four papers worth 45%, daily quizzes worth 35%, discussion posts 10%, and participation worth 10% of the final grade. He can be a tough grader but if you work hard, you can get the grade. He is very empathetic and understanding.
Great Professor. Puts a lot of effort into classes and you learn a lot. Must take!
amazing, 10/10 professor, one of the first classes I feel like I actually learned how to critically think rather just memorize facts

Dr. Kielty is very understanding, but is a tough grader. There are four short papers, which he offers incentives for. The rest of your grade is determined by discussion posts, class participation and in-class quizzes. There is a quiz for every class on the readings. The readings are super tough, but if you read the questions, the quizzes are easy.

Kielty is the greatest Professor I have had at Richmond. He gives excellent feedback, makes class very interesting, and gives reasonable assignments. The material is dense, but his ability to make class approachable / discussion based always left me feeling smarter than I was when I walked in. It is important to participate, but always worth it!

Dedication to his students is unsurpassed. Class isnt overly difficult, but his prompts and exams will really make you think, especially if hes your first prof in pol theory. Quite possibly the most intelligent prof Ive ever had, but hes very humble and wont leave you in the dust with the material either, so long as you do your part.

You can immediately just tell how intelligent and knowledgable this guy is. He is super passionate about the subject and wants to see his students to succeed. The class itself requires a lot of reading & you have to be willing to put in the work. Kielty is such an incredible professor who will teach you so much. I would highly recommend this course
